chapterBreakdown.direct:
The chapter introduces the matching operation as a judgment mechanism. It argues that outputs depend on how cases are matched to available frames.

That matters because judgment is not only about raw facts. It is also about whether a case is fitted to a category, a scale, or a response pattern in one way rather than another.

This is the distinction the chapter has to hold. Case-to-frame mapping shapes the result, but the mechanism is not a rigid formula. Matching matters without promising automatic correctness.

The limit stays visible. The chapter is explaining how judgments take shape, not claiming that a clean frame eliminates difficulty or disagreement.

That prepares the next step. After showing that matching drives outcomes, the book can focus more closely on scales.

That matters because the result does not come only from the raw case. It also comes from the slot, box, or scale the room uses to receive it.

This is where the chapter gets exact. Different docking points can steer the same case toward different outcomes, but the book refuses to pretend the machine is a perfect calculator.

The discipline stays narrow on purpose. The matching operation explains part of how the call is built, not how every judgment problem disappears.

That is what sets up the next step. Once the docking move is clear, the book can inspect scales directly.

chapterBreakdown.gentle:
Once the relation between bias and noise is clearer, the book can narrow its focus again. The chapter turns to the matching operation and asks how a case gets fitted to a category, scale, or response frame.

That matters because judgments are shaped not only by the case itself but also by the way the match gets made. The book is now naming a more specific mechanism inside judgment.

Hard depth sharpens the point. The same case can produce different outputs when it is matched to different frames, which means the mapping step is part of the judgment rather than an afterthought.

The chapter keeps one strict limit in place. Matching is not a formal equation, and it does not automatically solve the uncertainty or difficulty of judgment. The gain is explanatory precision, not certainty.

This is what changes after the broad comparison chapter. The reader no longer asks only which vocabulary fits best, but how the case is routed into the frame that will guide the response.

That is what earns the next move. Once the matching step is clear, the book can turn to scales.
chapterBreakdown.direct:
The chapter introduces the matching operation as a judgment mechanism. It argues that outputs depend on how cases are matched to available frames.

That matters because a judgment is shaped by more than the facts under review. It also depends on whether the case is fitted to one category, one scale, or one response pattern rather than another.

This is the harder distinction it wants to hold. Matching is an influential mechanism without becoming a rigid formula or a guarantee of correct judgment. The mapping step matters, but it does not make judgment automatic.

The limit is essential. The chapter stays conceptual and avoids pretending there is a neat mathematical scheme waiting underneath every call.

That is what sets up the next move. After showing how case-to-frame fit shapes judgment, the book can examine scales as one especially important frame.
chapterBreakdown.competitive:
The chapter stops talking only about the territory and opens a piece of machinery. It asks how the case gets docked to the frame that will shape the call.

That matters because the result is not just sitting inside the facts waiting to be collected. The room has to route the case into a box, slot, or scale, and that routing changes the call.

This is where the chapter gets sharp. The docking move influences the outcome, but the book refuses to sell it as a perfect calculator or a royal formula.

The discipline stays tight. No fake equation appears, and no one gets to pretend that choosing a frame ends the need for judgment.

That is what earns the next step. Once the docking gear is visible, the book can walk straight into scales.
